test_title: PYST 73: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On 24 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom in the following sentence.

Instead of confusing others, let us __call a spade a spade__ in front of the audience.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

**__Key Points__**

 
• The idiom **"call a spade a spade"** means to speak truthfully and directly about something, even if it is unpleasant. (स्पष्ट रूप से बोलना)
 
 
• **Example: **Instead of sugarcoating the situation, he always calls a spade a spade.
 
 
 
• **Speak truthfully** means to tell the truth without any hesitation or alteration. (सच्चाई से बोलना)
 
 
• **Example: **She always speaks truthfully, no matter how hard the truth might be.
